digest.component_or_area: plan-review clarity measure and deterministic scoring
propositions: Current clarity score duplicated across gates.py and det_floor.py rewards volume and legacy shape rather than enforcing author-guide leaf/container contracts, permitting padded plans to pass without required sections.

Deterministic detection rules for six candidate checks—required-section shape by graph altitude, per-AC verification coverage, placeholder-free Scope/Approach, grounded edit-set, AC text hygiene, and Testing shape markers—can be mechanically testable without LLM judgment.
Clarity scoring should derive from per-check evidence and satisfied/applicable checks rather than adding points to a scale where filler compensates for missing sections.

Author-guide and criteria-guide conflict on Success Criteria (collapsed to Acceptance Criteria per epic 1386) and rejected-alternative requirement (G6 requires positive rationale only); clarifying guidance should not encode Success Criteria and should defer rejected-alternative checks pending bug 828a-7407-9d68-4b82 resolution.
